WITH per_event_name AS (
    SELECT e.event_name, AVG(b.amount) AS avg_budget_amount
    FROM budget AS b
    JOIN event AS e ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event
    GROUP BY e.event_name
), overall AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_budget_amount) AS overall_avg
    FROM per_event_name
), above_average AS (
    SELECT p.event_name, p.avg_budget_amount, o.overall_avg
    FROM per_event_name AS p
    CROSS JOIN overall AS o
    WHERE p.avg_budget_amount > o.overall_avg
), kept_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_budget_amount) AS kept_avg
    FROM above_average
)
SELECT a.event_name,
       a.avg_budget_amount,
       a.avg_budget_amount - a.overall_avg AS difference_from_overall_average,
       a.avg_budget_amount / k.kept_avg AS ratio_to_kept_average
FROM above_average AS a
CROSS JOIN kept_average AS k;
